title: San Francisco Building Footprints geometry and LiDAR height source lock
nativeVerticalDatum: NAVD 1988 where explicitly declared by the source fields

source.publisher: City and County of San Francisco
source.attribution: City and County of San Francisco

snapshot.identity: byte-locked DataSF Building Footprints bulk CSV export

coordinateReference.horizontal: WGS 84 longitude/latitude coordinates serialized as WKT (EPSG:4326)

vertical.p2010_zminn88ft: 2010 input building mass minimum Z vertex elevation, NAVD 1988 feet
vertical.p2010_zmaxn88ft: 2010 input building mass maximum Z vertex elevation, NAVD 1988 feet
vertical.gnd_min_m: zonal minimum ground surface height, NAVD 1988 metres
vertical.median_1st_m: zonal median first-return surface height, NAVD 1988 metres
vertical.hgt_median_m: zonal median height-surface value, metres; the source description does not declare this field as an absolute elevation
vertical.gnd1st_delta: median first-return surface minus minimum bare-earth surface, metres
vertical.peak_1st_m: highest first-return cell value in the building zone, NAVD 1988 metres

approvedScope.place: Building footprint records present in the locked citywide DataSF export
geometry: source-declared LiDAR and 2010 building-mass height fields
permitted: deterministic preview-only Ferry and district extracts
source-to-source footprint and height comparison with byte-locked OSM buildings
preview-only building massing validation with explicit field-level provenance
prohibited: production tile, runtime, collision, navigation, or gameplay promotion without a separate reviewed authorization
claiming facade materials, windows, doors, floor plans, occupancy, or current building use
treating p2010 height fields as current 2023 building massing
combining NAVD 1988 absolute elevations with current production terrain before vertical reconciliation is implemented and verified
survey-grade, exact, or sub-metre accuracy claims
silently substituting median or peak height fields for one another
